rules.colorUsage: For dark institutional invitations: background must be KAAE Midnight Navy (#0A1628) or Royal Navy (#1E3A5F). Dates must be Kurdistan Sun Gold (#F7B500). The title takes the color the design calls for, from this palette: Sun Gold is an accent, for an accent line of the title, not a rule on the whole title. Body copy must be Academic Cream (#FDF8F3) or White (#FFFFFF). Dividers and borders must be Sun Gold (#F7B500) or Primary Blue (#4770A3). Never use purple, violet, indigo, or unlisted colors.
rules.logo: Use the supplied official logo unchanged, with its original aspect ratio. Minimum digital width 100px. Keep clear space around it equal to the height of its K.
rules.body: Left align digital body text. Use 1.4 line spacing, readable text and academic formality.
rules.restriction: Do not add reference-document factual copy, contact details, slogans, signatures or a seal to the invitation. Only the saved request supplies design copy.
rules.scriptFontNote: Provisional Sorani Kurdish typeface for drafts only: the brand guideline copy in this pack records no Kurdish typeface. The art director confirms the brand font before any release.
rules.rtl: Sorani Kurdish blocks are right-to-left: right-align them, keep them separate from Latin blocks, and give them about 20% more width and height than Latin text of the same size.
artDirection: Pick ONE hero photo that literally shows the subject. A second photo only as a texture blended into the text zone, never a grid cell. No multi-photo grids in social posts.
The hero fills 60-100% of the canvas and runs off at least two edges. Keep a quiet region (sky, wall, blur) for the title.
Text always sits on something: a cream card (22-25% of the height), a navy plate or panel, or a navy gradient fade over 35-50% of the height. Never bare text on a busy photo.
Elements bridge edges: a wordmark tab straddling the card's top edge, a call-to-action tab straddling a card, a portrait breaking over a panel.
People: cut out, placed bottom-left or left, bleeding off the edge, with the sunburst or grid motif behind. No circle masks.
A gold border frames series and carousels; a thin gold inset line frames single report posts. Never tilt or rotate photos.
Colour: navy for fades, plates and scrims; gold only for the first title line, rules, call-to-action pills and frames; cream for card fills. Keep the photo's natural grade (no duotone).
Type: bold geometric sans. A gold line and a bold white or navy main line for the title, then small light body text. Logo in a corner; the URL in a pill or the footer.
Bilingual: the same geometry in both languages. Sorani is right-aligned or centred in the same boxes; never mirror the photo.
With several photos, rank them by subject fit, sharpness and quiet space. Use the best as the hero, optionally one more as a faded texture, and drop the rest.
rules.artDirectionSource: Office art-direction rulebook, from ~20 of KAAE's published photo designs (ADR-170, 2026-09-30).
